body:
This PR adds `AbstractEvent` for the reporting infrastructure which includes the start of the calibration, the start and end of each iteration, and the end of the calibration. All the reporters now update at the end of each iteration. Furthermore, the `WalltimeReporter` is updated to use the start of the calibration for the initial time. Finally, a `ReportContext` struct is added which simplifies passing inputs to the reporters. This also allow for more inputs to be added without it being a breaking change.

I asked a LLM to write a majority of this code.
title: Add events for reporters and ReportContext
